status: Accepted; concrete quantities and development constants pending end-to-end calibration, before formal PPO or confirmation evaluation
question: Can one PPO seed improve a closed-loop-validated clone of a feasible rule within the same structured sparse native-expert interface? This evaluates the combined method, not isolated causal contributions.
frozen: All other weights, including routers, attention, norms and output head
precision: BF16 forward; FP32 editable master parameters, gradients and Adam first/second moments; full actual AdamW displacement gating including decay
optional_long_history: Four tasks only if spare time; separate reporting, never pooled into main means
interface: Per layer one base multiplier and zero/one/two distinct expert corrections; alphabet 0,.25,.5,.75,1; no hard global keep gate. Exact generative ordering/masks to be locked before rule/clone/PPO comparisons.
environment_objective: R=-F_full_T/s_F-kappa*N_fail; full retained online monitor memory, equal old-task weighting, fixed completion baselines; final evaluation never enters reward
reward_rewrite: gamma=1; cache z_t. Ordinary r_t=(z_t-z_{t+1})/s_F; last r=(z_last-F_full_T)/s_F-kappa*N_fail. Assert sum(r)=-F_full_T/s_F-kappa*N_fail+z_0/s_F. Never add the original terminal reward again.
boundaries: Task switch and PPO collection truncation are not true episode terminals. Preserve cached potential and monitor state; bootstrap truncation. Full-monitor correction and failure penalty occur at true history termination only. Exact abort/zero-decision semantics to be locked before training.
exploration: Positive smoothing over all valid action factors, with epsilon definition frozen in development; greedy clone reproduction and stochastic perturbation assessed separately
clone_gate: Reuse rule observations first; independently execute clone on the same development histories. Do not select by action MAE or hand a clear distillation failure to PPO. Bounded repair; if rule or clone remains infeasible, stop expensive PPO and report untested components.
evaluation: Development-only checkpoint and execution-mode selection, then locked confirmation; all failures, unfinished histories and paired common-success sets retained
old_protocol_activity: Only four real learner updates for engineering smoke; no full old-protocol rollout or formal PPO. Five old CPU mechanism tests, including old dense-action probability checks, are not the new sparse-interface validation.
valid_prior_work: Download, pinned environment, 805306368-parameter scope, BF16/FP32 engineering profile and checkpoint recovery remain valid; no redo or budget reset
